cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0091 NEW)
set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded")
project(issue_172_probe CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(WITH_MKL OFF CACHE BOOL "")
set(WITH_RUY ON CACHE BOOL "")
set(OPENMP_RUNTIME NONE CACHE STRING "")
set(BUILD_CLI OFF CACHE BOOL "")
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "")
add_subdirectory("${CT2_SOURCE}" ct2)
add_executable(probe probe.cc)
target_include_directories(probe PRIVATE "${CT2_SOURCE}/src" "${CT2_SOURCE}/third_party")
target_compile_definitions(probe PRIVATE CT2_X86_BUILD)
target_link_libraries(probe PRIVATE ctranslate2)
target_link_options(probe PRIVATE /DEBUG "/MAP:${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/probe.map")
